The nonzero cubic coefficient and positive parameter derivative give an analytic equation in z², recovering the claimed square-root coefficient and O((a−a_c)^(3/2)) error. At fixed a, atanh(u)/u increases from 1 to infinity and gives the stated duration classification. The claim is an idealized deterministic model, not empirical.
